title: finding(scripts/ci): the spec-main shape gate reports a LOWER BOUND — `&&` inside type-check and turbo fail-fast hide 19 of 20 diagnostics, so objectui#9880 is 1 of at least 7 independent sites
body:
objectui#9860's spec-`main` shape gate reports a **LOWER BOUND**, structurally — and that changes what the decision on PR objectui#9877 is about. Measured by the objectui#9880 dev on the main-built leg (objectstack `07c6f822`), using the gate's own injection mechanism, on a pristine tree.

## Two independent maskers, both mechanical

1. **`&&` inside each package's `type-check`.** It is `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, so on a package that is already red the **tests project never runs** and its diagnostics never reach the annotation step.
2. **turbo fail-fast.** `turbo run type-check` without `--continue` **cancels the dependents** of a failed task.

⇒ ⭐ **the same census, same commit, same command family: 1 diagnostic without `--continue`, 20 with it.**

## The census, with `--continue`

**20 unique diagnostics across 7 packages** — `core` 2 · `plugin-view` 3 · `types` 6 · `react` 1 · `console` 1 · `app-shell` 6 · `example-byo-backend-console` 1. The last two groups (**7**) are **CASCADE** from `plugin-view`'s failed build ⇒ **13 non-cascade across 5 packages**. (The job log prints 29 `error TS` lines because `plugin-view`'s three are emitted under both its `build` and its `type-check` task — ⛔ line count is not diagnostic count.)

⇒ ⚠️ **objectui#9880 is 1 of at least 7 independent sites**, so 「fix objectui#9880 and the gate goes green」 is FALSE. Landing objectui#9877 after that card would still put a red advisory check on every pull request — the 「advisory 门禁红着进 main 是共享损伤」 shape that is the reason it is held.

## The sites the census names, ⛔ none of them fixed and ⛔ none of them diagnosed beyond what is written here

| package | site | shape |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `plugin-view` | `ViewSwitcher.tsx` ×2, `ObjectView.tsx` ×1 | `page:` rows in totals over the whole `ViewType` ⇒ TS2353. **Carded: objectui#9943** |
| `core` | `src/validation/__tests__/object-validation-engine.test.ts` | `{ dialect: 'cel', ast: … }` without `source` no longer satisfies the spec's expression union. ⭐ **Proven PRE-EXISTING** by a controlled run against the reverted source. Dedupe: `object-validation-engine dialect source expression wire` · `spec main expression union requires source` |
| `types` | `view-navigation-config-spec-parity.test.ts` (5) · `gantt-declared-keys.test.ts` (1) | TS2322 `Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'undefined'`. ⭐ These are the downstream of objectstack#19049 (a navigation entry's `label` became OPTIONAL) — the same relaxation objectui#9868 is now held on. Dedupe: `view-navigation-config-spec-parity string not assignable undefined` · `types gantt-declared-keys TS2322 main spec` |
| `react` | `useNavigationOverlay.modeDefault.test.tsx` (1) | same TS2322 family as the row above |
| `console` | `src/__tests__/timelineAxisRefusalReach-7070.test.tsx` | TS2740: a props object missing `className`, `activeViewId`, `onViewChange`, `onRowClick` and 6 more. ⚠️ **Measured, ⛔ not diagnosed.** Dedupe: `console timelineAxisRefusalReach TS2740 missing props` · `ObjectViewProps required props main spec` |

⚠️ One more, deliberately **not** carded as a repair: `normalize-list-view.pageResidual-8429.test.ts` is red on the main leg and **cannot** be made both-legs-total — its own header declares it the tripwire for exactly this narrowing, and its assertions are TRUE today on the published leg. It is a **CONVERSION owed at the pin bump**, ⛔ not a repair, and converting it now would be a disposition call on objectui#8429 that nobody has been given. Carrier: the `@objectstack/spec` pin-bump pull request, which is already a named scripted action.

## ⛔ What this card does NOT propose

⛔ Not that the gate be weakened, narrowed, made non-blocking or deleted — it is doing its job, and the under-report is a property of the commands it runs, not of its intent. Whether the fix is `--continue`, splitting the two `tsc` invocations into separate tasks, or reporting per-package rather than per-run is the claiming seat's to measure. ⛔ And this card does not decide objectui#9877's hold-or-land question; it supplies the number that question turns on.
